items.reason: The initial interim RFS benefit was not sustained on updated analysis (updated RFS HR 1.26, 95% CI 0.85–1.87); the NCCN HCC Version 2.2026 Insights states that the recommendation was subsequently removed and that there is no adjuvant strategy at this time.
items.action: Retain the initial and updated reports together as one study; use as contrary/withdrawn-recommendation evidence in a dedicated review, not as a new trial page.

items.reason: Phase III: 8-year MFS-CI 74% vs 72%, HR 0.88 (95% CI 0.67–1.15), P=0.34; no overall MFS-CI or OS improvement. Prespecified pelvic-node RT subgroup (n=324) showed HR 0.47 (95% CI 0.29–0.76), adjusted P=0.004; interpret as subgroup signal, not overall success.
items.next_action: Retain for contrary-evidence synthesis on ARPI intensification with definitive RT.

items.reason: 71,122 vs 71,128 randomized; primary stage III/IV incidence IRR 1.03 (95% CI 0.92–1.14), P=0.63. Stage IV IRR 0.86 (95% CI 0.74–1.00) after three rounds; further follow-up required.
items.next_action: Retain for screening-policy contrary-evidence review; do not claim mortality benefit.

items.site: Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
items.reason: Randomized phase II: 69 randomized, 66 treated; ORR 15.6% with danvatirsen+pembrolizumab vs 14.3% with pembrolizumab, risk difference 1.3, P=1.0; stopped for lack of response.
items.next_action: Retain as negative STAT3/PD-1 combination evidence.

items.reason: PFS 8.4 vs 6.7 months, HR 0.76 (95% CI 0.48–1.19), P=0.12; OS 20 vs 18 months, P=0.18; no significant benefit in the unselected population.
items.next_action: Retain as contrary evidence against unselected PD-1 addition to SG; do not over-interpret exploratory PD-L1 subgroup.

items.reason: Phase III: in the CR/PR primary population median BICR PFS was 5.55 months in both arms; HR 1.00 (95% CI 0.79–1.27), one-sided P=0.502. Key secondary endpoints were not formally tested after hierarchical failure. No efficacy gain from adding niraparib.
items.next_action: Retain as negative maintenance-intensification evidence; do not present exploratory secondary outcomes as formally positive.

items.reason: The prespecified hierarchical primary comparison of atezolizumab plus tiragolumab versus placebo did not improve investigator PFS (HR 0.82, 95% CI 0.65–1.03; P=0.0947) or OS (HR 0.91, 95% CI 0.70–1.18). Atezolizumab-alone comparisons were reported as descriptive after the hierarchy failed; do not claim a confirmatory positive primary endpoint.
items.next_action: Retain for nuanced consolidation evidence review; extract full protocol hierarchy and distinguish descriptive atezolizumab-alone findings from confirmatory testing.

items.site: Recurrent/Metastatic Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
items.reason: Randomized phase II; only 31 patients randomized after early termination. Nivolumab-ipilimumab versus docetaxel: ORR 0% vs 17.6%, median PFS 1.97 vs 3.66 months (P=0.036), median OS 3.97 vs 11.9 months; NIVO-IPI did not improve efficacy and showed numerically inferior survival.
items.next_action: Retain as small, early-terminated negative post-PD-1 rechallenge evidence; avoid overinterpreting the underpowered OS comparison.

items.trial: Induction TPF versus adjuvant PF after CCRT in locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma
items.setting: Locally advanced; induction versus adjuvant chemotherapy around CCRT
items.reason: Phase III randomized study, N=266: 3-year PFS 79.0% with induction TPF plus CCRT versus 74.5% with CCRT followed by PF (P=0.454); no significant OS, LRFS or DMFS difference. Induction TPF increased grade 3–4 leukopenia and neutropenia.
items.next_action: Retain as sequencing/contrary evidence; extract full dose schedules and toxicity denominators before any clinical summary.
